# Calendar — standalone HTML shell

Auto-generated by `mosaic-compile --backend html --emit-project`.

## Prerequisites

None. The shell is a static HTML document.

## View

Open `index.html` in any browser:

```sh
open index.html      # macOS
xdg-open index.html  # Linux
start index.html     # Windows
```

## Host integration

`main.js` hydrates `{slot}` placeholders from `window.mosaicHost.getProps` and sends `data-on-*` events to `window.mosaicHost.handleEvent`. If no host is installed, it uses deterministic sample props for every slot.

## What's in this directory

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `Calendar.html` | The Mosaic-compiled HTML fragment. Embed this in your own page. |
| `index.html` | A complete `<!DOCTYPE html>` shell that inlines the fragment. Open in a browser to view. |
| `main.js` | Dependency-free Mosaic HTML runtime for slot hydration and host event dispatch. |
| `README.md` | This file. |

## Editing

`index.html`, `main.js`, and `README.md` carry an AUTO-GENERATED banner. Re-running `mosaic-compile --emit-project` will overwrite them. To customise the shell, remove the banner from a file and rename or relocate it; the next `--emit-project` run will recreate the original at its original name without touching your forked copy.
